title: Derivative Squares Under Boolean Duality
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. Define the dual function by $f^*(x)=-f(-x)$, and for a real-valued function $g$ define $D_i g(x)$ as half the difference between its values at $x$ with coordinate $i$ set to $1$ and to $-1$. Then $(D_i f^*(x))^2=(D_i f(-x))^2$.
